Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherloom
Description: Inspect Glamourer designs against the current character's carried and stored equipment.
Punchline: Plan outfits from your FFXIV wardrobe.
Changelog: Use upstream Glamourer for linked appearance bases and first-time wardrobe migration. The base picker discovers tagged designs through public IPC, and existing links resolve by design ID for preview, manual apply and assignments. Empty wardrobe folders are recovered from Glamourer’s saved organization during migration.
